# Contact

- Route: `/contact`
- Kind: `page`
- Category: `support`

## Summary

Contact the people behind Media Manipulator: support and billing at support@media-manipulator.com, privacy requests at privacy@media-manipulator.com, or the contact form. We usually reply within two business days.

## Details

Contact Media Manipulator
Questions, bug reports, billing problems, privacy requests or a partnership idea: send a message with the form or email us directly. A person reads every message.
Who you are writing to
Media Manipulator is built and run by Mitchell Wintrow, its founder and sole engineer, and operated by CreaTV Ltd. in Colorado, USA. No outside support company answers on our behalf. <linkAbout>More about who makes Media Manipulator</linkAbout>.
Email
Support, bugs and billing
Privacy and data requests
We usually reply within two business days.
Reporting a bug
We can fix a problem much faster when your first message includes:
the tool you used, or the address of its page;
the file type and roughly how large the file was;
your browser and device;
what you expected, what happened instead, and any error message you saw.
Please do not attach the file itself unless we ask for it.
If a tool seems to be down for everyone, the <linkStatus>status page</linkStatus> shows whether our servers are healthy right now.
We use your name, email address and message only to answer you. They are kept in our support mailbox until the conversation is closed, and never longer than 12 months. Section 1.11 of the <linkPrivacy>privacy policy</linkPrivacy> has the details.
